summary: Salut à Toi is a libre, decentralized communication tool featuring multiple frontends. It operates within the XMPP ecosystem to provide a messaging and collaboration environment hosted on your own hardware.
goodFor: This is suitable if you prefer decentralized XMPP-based communication systems and want to experiment with alternative web clients.
watchOut: Activity and release history appear sparse, suggesting you may encounter maintenance hurdles, missing documentation, or limited community support.
deployNotes: As a Python application, it will typically require a WSGI-compatible setup behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination, along with persistent storage for application data and an external database.
